main_text.p: visa mihi sunt, quæ tu ex collatione Sa-maritici Pentateuchi cum Hebraico observasti; & sane auctor tibi sum, ut qua diligentia facis, de Religione, deque litteris bene mereri pergas.

p.i: Vale. Romæ die XIII. Julii M. DC XXVIII.

main_text.head: EPIST. VIII.
Jo. Morinus Hier. Aleandro de eodem Argumento.

p.i: Clarissimo & Doctissimo viro Hier. Aleandro Joan. Morinus. S. D.

main_text.p: MIssæ sunt ad me Parisiis Lugdunum, quò Lugdunensem Archiepisco-pum, qui nunc obiit, comitatus eram, binæ litteræ tuæ, utraque benevolentiæ er-game tuæ signa secum deferentes, priores duorum siclorum ἔντυπα, unius vero posteriores; lætitia sane non modica perfusus sum, cum coepta mea precesq; adeo cordi tibi fuisse animadverti, ut de iis ju-vandis tam sæpe cogitares: rem fecisti mihi gratissimam, quæqve me tibi arctis-simò devinctum tenet. Paulo maturius lit-

page.notes: The drop cap M is joined to "Issæ" as "MIssæ". "ergame" at the line end is read as "ergamę" with [?] advised: the word is "ergame" or "erga me". The Greek word "ἔντυπα" is read with an uncertain breathing mark. "Julii" is printed in italic and the initial could be I or J. The text ends on the half word "lit-"; the catchword "teris" is at the foot. Long s is read as plain s throughout.
